# pve_realm (Resource)

Authentication realm (PAM, PVE, LDAP, OpenID, …).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_realm" "example" {
  realm = "CHANGE_ME"
  type  = "ad"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `realm` (String) Authentication domain ID
- `type` (String) Realm type. One of: `ad`, `ldap`, `openid`, `pam`, `pve`.

### Optional

- `acr_values` (String) Specifies the Authentication Context Class Reference values that theAuthorization Server is being requested to use for the Auth Request.
- `audiences` (String) A list of audiences that the OpenID Issuer may include that are accepted in addition to 'client-id'.
- `autocreate` (Boolean) Automatically create users if they do not exist. (default: 0)
- `base_dn` (String) LDAP base domain name
- `bind_dn` (String) LDAP bind domain name
- `capath` (String) Path to the CA certificate store (default: /etc/ssl/certs)
- `case_sensitive` (Boolean) username is case-sensitive (default: 1)
- `cert` (String) Path to the client certificate
- `certkey` (String) Path to the client certificate key
- `check_connection` (Boolean) Check bind connection to the server. (default: 0)
- `client_id` (String) OpenID Client ID
- `client_key` (String) OpenID Client Key
- `comment` (String) Description.
- `default` (Boolean) Use this as default realm
- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `domain` (String) AD domain name
- `filter` (String) LDAP filter for user sync.
- `group_classes` (String) The objectclasses for groups. (default: groupOfNames, group, univentionGroup, ipausergroup)
- `group_dn` (String) LDAP base domain name for group sync. If not set, the base_dn will be used.
- `group_filter` (String) LDAP filter for group sync.
- `group_name_attr` (String) LDAP attribute representing a groups name. If not set or found, the first value of the DN will be used as name.
- `groups_autocreate` (Boolean) Automatically create groups if they do not exist. (default: 0)
- `groups_claim` (String) OpenID claim used to retrieve groups with.
- `groups_overwrite` (Boolean) All groups will be overwritten for the user on login. (default: 0)
- `issuer_url` (String) OpenID Issuer Url
- `mode` (String) LDAP protocol mode. (default: ldap) One of: `ldap`, `ldaps`, `ldap+starttls`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) LDAP bind password. Will be stored in '/etc/pve/priv/realm/<REALM>.pw'.
- `port` (Number) Server port.
- `prompt` (String) Specifies whether the Authorization Server prompts the End-User for reauthentication and consent.
- `query_userinfo` (Boolean) Enables querying the userinfo endpoint for claims values. (default: 1)
- `scopes` (String) Specifies the scopes (user details) that should be authorized and returned, for example 'email' or 'profile'. (default: email profile)
- `secure` (Boolean) Use secure LDAPS protocol. DEPRECATED: use 'mode' instead.
- `server1` (String) Server IP address (or DNS name)
- `server2` (String) Fallback Server IP address (or DNS name)
- `sslversion` (String) LDAPS TLS/SSL version. It's not recommended to use version older than 1.2! One of: `tlsv1`, `tlsv1_1`, `tlsv1_2`, `tlsv1_3`.
- `sync_attributes` (String) Comma separated list of key=value pairs for specifying which LDAP attributes map to which PVE user field. For example, to map the LDAP attribute 'mail' to PVEs 'email', write  'email=mail'. By default, each PVE user field is represented  by an LDAP attribute of the same name.
- `sync_defaults_options` (String) The default options for behavior of synchronizations.
- `tfa` (String) Use Two-factor authentication.
- `user_attr` (String) LDAP user attribute name
- `user_classes` (String) The objectclasses for users. (default: inetorgperson, posixaccount, person, user)
- `username_claim` (String) OpenID claim used to generate the unique username.
- `verify` (Boolean) Verify the server's SSL certificate (default: 0)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: realm (also the `terraform import` format).
